avis.titre: Smells like Fruit Loops and works wonderfully
avis.texte: I was so pleasantly surprised at the smell, the foaming, the spreadability, how it left my skin feeling soft instead of stripped, but then I was so extra happy to find that I stopped my breakouts while I was using my sample tube. I'm absolutely buying a full size one. I love it so much!

I was looking for a new nighttime face wash, this cleanser popped up in my recommended as I use many items from this brand. This stuff is AMAZING!!! I have combination skin, oily nose but the rest is dry dry dry. It leaves my skin feeling clean without the stripped feeling. Definitely a new staple in my routine!

I was excited to try Korean skincare and this face wash had so msby hood yhings in it and felt great on my skin. Unfortunately, within a couple days, my entire face exploded in contact dermatitis. The itch and redness were so bad I didnt want to leave the house. It was dry and covered in blisters. After 2 days without use, my skin is nearly normal. Hopefully others have a better experience. This has never happened to me with a face cleanser and i do not have sensitive skin.
